snippet.title: A WEEK AT POLAR'S BUFFET: TRAILER 2
snippet.description:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
You are the brand new nightguard of Polar's Artic Frenzy Buffet. After the previous one retired from the position. You will spend your whole first week in this nearly forgotten restaurant, make sure nothing gets in, and nothing gets out.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This game has a 2.5D artstyle, with 3d enviroments and 2d characters. The building is 3D Modelled, the props are 3D and 2D, and the characters are 2D.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PLAY A WEEK AT POLAR'S BUFFET AT:
https://gamejolt.com/games/aweekatpolars/926470
https://marcelogtoonz.itch.io/a-week-at-polars-buffet
